capabilities: Render a Base as a Kanban board with status columns
Drag cards to change status, order and grouping
Schedule cards on a calendar or Gantt timeline
Roll up progress and estimates in a WBS tree
Track time and run pomodoro sessions on cards
disambiguation: Not only a Kanban board: the same Base also renders calendars, timelines, WBS trees and an agenda.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13+ (Bases view API); detailed usage lives in an external usage guide; unused modes can be switched off globally in settings.
intentEvidence: adds a Kanban board view to Obsidian Bases, so you can plan, track, and schedule
motivation: I built this because I wanted my planning to live in my notes, not in yet another app.
problem: Obsidian's Bases list notes but give no way to drag them through statuses, schedule them, or see their hierarchy.

relations.evidence: let the Obsidian Starter Kit plugin configure them for you when it's installed
applies the template with Templater when you have it
tasknotes-style time_estimate minutes, converted via a configurable minutes-per-day

summary: Bases view that turns notes into Kanban boards, calendars, timelines and WBS trees, with time tracking and automation rules.
